title: claim treats an unreadable or missing owner.json as no previous owner, so a different user inherits the old user's data
trigger: Sign in as user A, owner.json write fails (full disk, read-only) or the file is corrupt or deleted; A logs out without forget finishing or the folder predates owner.json; user B signs in on the same account-N slot
effect: previous is None, so claim returns false and nothing is forgotten: B sees A's agent grants, mini app trust, recent hashtags, widget storage and mini app web data
fix: Make the owner a typed `Owner::{Unknown, Known(user_id)}`; Unknown with leftover per-account files counts as someone else and forgets, and a failed owner write is reported instead of only logged.

title: request_passkeys clears stale and error before the send; a failed send loses the stale refetch
trigger: Remove a passkey (marks list stale), the refetch send fails.
effect: state.stale=false and requested_at set before send_json_request; on Err the list stays showing the removed passkey and the 5 s throttle blocks the next attempt.
fix: Fetch<Passkeys> with Stale cleared by the answer; set requested_at only after a successful send.

title: An export worker that panics ends without publishing a settled stage; the progress box never gets Done
trigger: The account (or chat) export worker thread panics inside spawn_guarded (any future indexing/unwrap bug, or the debug_assert in ResultJson::field in debug builds). guarded() swallows it, the closure's trailing publish(Failed) never runs, only the alive sender drops.
effect: Progress stays at e.g. 'Chats: 3 of 40' for ever, the Done button (only shown when settled) never appears, a new export is refused with 'already running', and every Quit shows 'Stop and quit?'. worker_ended() is not read anywhere outside tests to settle it.
fix: Settle on worker end: a drop guard in the thread body that publishes Failed('stopped unexpectedly') when no final stage was written, or poll worker_ended() and map it to a Failed stage.

title: A failed or cancelled account export leaves a truncated, unterminated result.json and no export_results.html
trigger: Start a JSON-format account export of many chats, press Cancel (or lose the connection so a section call fails) midway.
effect: The DataExport folder keeps result.json cut off mid-array (ResultJson::finish and the index page are only written on the success path), so a later tool reading it fails or silently sees a partial export, and the folder holds private account data with no marker that it is incomplete.
fix: On Err/Cancel finish the ResultJson (close arrays) or write an 'incomplete' marker; better, write to result.json.part and rename on success.

title: adding sticks when the addLoginPasskey answer cannot be parsed or its continuation is dropped
trigger: Create Passkey; complete the ceremony; the server's `passkey` answer has no id (Passkey::parse returns None, parse_payload returns None) or the request is dropped by a reconnect/closed client.
effect: `adding` is cleared only by accept_added and the Add error arm. Otherwise passkey_creation_busy() stays true and begin_register/finish_register refuse (`state.adding`), so Create Passkey stays disabled for the rest of the session.
fix: One enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(options), Sending(request), Done } with the request id; clear Sending on any answer to that id and when the request is dropped.

title: An in-flight list answer undoes a removal and clears the stale mark
trigger: Open Passkeys (getLoginPasskeys in flight), delete a passkey before the list answer lands. removeLoginPasskey ok sets stale=true but request_passkeys skips because the List is in flight; then the older list answer arrives.
effect: accept_list replaces the list (the deleted passkey is back), sets known=true and stale=false, so no refetch happens and the deleted passkey shows until the user leaves and returns after more than 5 s.
fix: Carry a list generation (bumped by finish_remove) in the List request and apply the answer only when it matches; otherwise keep stale=true.

title: Passkey creation options that arrive after the user cancelled still start a system sheet
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Passkeys > Create Passkey, then Cancel/Esc (close_passkey_ceremony) before getPasskeyParameters answers.
effect: close_passkey_ceremony only clears the UI ceremony; the request is not cancelled and the driver's `passkeys.ceremony` is not cleared. apply_passkey_parameters then stores `ceremony`, the still-running ticker (passkey_creation_busy is true while the request is in flight) takes it in tick_passkey_ceremony and starts a hardware-key/system ceremony with a box the user already closed.
fix: Tie the options to a request id held in the registration enum; closing the box moves the stage to Idle so a late answer is ignored.

title: A theme save that fails after the QR box closed is dropped without a word
trigger: Pick a new backdrop in your QR box, close the box (Closing sends setProfileShareTheme), then the request fails (offline, rights lost)
effect: The box is gone and the poll step clears save_answers when no box is open (ui/peer_qr/mod.rs drain_peer_qr), so no toast; the person believes the theme was saved but the server still has the old one
fix: Report a save failure through the app's note (set_note) when no box is open to take the answer, or keep the failed pick in the session until the next box shows it.

title: Quarantining a corrupt accounts.json forgets pending_deletes, so a requested wipe is not finished
trigger: lock-screen Log out records every account in pending_deletes, Quill quits or crashes, accounts.json is found unparsable on the next start
effect: the file is renamed aside and the default registry (primary, no pending deletes) is used; the folders the user asked to wipe stay on disk and primary opens its old database
fix: On a corrupt registry, recover pending_deletes from the quarantined text (or a separate wipe marker file) before starting any client.

title: After a partly failed review, retry re-sends confirmSession/terminateSession for sessions already reviewed
trigger: Two unconfirmed sessions; one confirmSession answers ok and the other errors; user presses Yes again
effect: unconfirmed_entries is kept whole on error (only cleared on a fully clean review), so the retry includes the already confirmed session and errors again; the banner keeps the old error text until the next press
fix: Remove an entry when its own request succeeds; keep per-entry result in the Reviewing stage.

title: A hidden account export pops its progress box open again after switching accounts and back
trigger: Settings > Data & Storage > Export Telegram data > Start, press Hide; switch to account B; switch back to account A while the export still runs.
effect: DialogUi (OnScreen) is rebuilt on each switch, so account_export_progress_hidden is back to false while A's Session still holds settings.account_export; the AccountExport is_open (`!hidden && export.is_some()`) is true and the progress box opens unasked over A's main window.
fix: Keep whether the progress is shown with the export itself (an AccountExport view stage in the Session next to account_export, or derive 'shown' from an explicit Open request), not in a screen flag whose default means 'shown'.

title: A failed account switch has already torn down the screen, and a failed set_active_account leaves no account on screen
trigger: Accounts > Switch to another account when the app root is unavailable or credentials are missing (screen wiped, old account kept), or when writing the active-account record fails (read-only or full disk).
effect: end_account_surfaces (farewell + replace_screen, new epoch) runs before the safe_app_root/credentials checks, so the first failures close the open chat and every box while self.live stays the same account. If set_active_account fails, retire_live_to_background already moved the client away and the function returns with self.live None: the window shows no account, and the Accounts dialog still marks the old account Active (from disk) with no Switch button for it, so only a restart brings it back.
fix: Check everything that can fail (root, credentials, the active-account write) before end_account_surfaces/retire_live_to_background, or roll back by adopting the retired client; put_on_screen should be the one place where live and the screen change together.

title: Registration form is cleared when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: On the sign-up step enter a name, accept the terms, press Create Account; the server rejects it (invalid name, flood) and auth stays WaitRegistration.
effect: submit_registration clears first and last name and accepted_registration_terms on a successful send; the answer is an error, the form is empty and the terms checkbox is unticked again, so the user retypes everything. submit_email does the same for the email (auth_ui.rs:44).
fix: Clear on the accepted answer (auth leaves WaitRegistration), or keep the values and only clear when the step changes.

title: Lock-screen log out ignores Deletion::Done { error } and reconnects as if the wipe worked
trigger: Lock Quill, press Log out on the lock screen while one account folder cannot be deleted (file held open, permissions).
effect: The passcode is already forgotten (forget_passcode runs before the wipe). The done closure matches Deletion::Done { .. }, drops the error, clears wiping, calls disk_accounts_wiped and start_connection. The user sees a fresh sign-in with no note while the old account's data is still on disk until the next start.
fix: Handle Done { error: Some(_) } like Deferred: keep a note that the data is still there, and do not report the wipe as complete.

title: Background accounts get the raw window focus as app_active, not the lock-aware value the on-screen account gets
trigger: Have two accounts. Lock Quill with a passcode and leave its lock screen focused (or just use Quill in the foreground). A message or reaction arrives on the account that is not on screen.
effect: poll_background copies frame.window_active (OS focus of any Quill window) into every background session's app_active. decide_notification_sound and decide_reaction_notify return nothing while app_active is true, so the background account makes no sound and no reaction notification while Quill is locked but focused. poll_live uses !refused_while_locked() && main focus for the on-screen account, and lock-is-a-render-state.md section 4 says background sessions get the same value.
fix: One 'looked at' value (focus and not locked) computed in one place and used by poll_live and poll_background; a background account is never looked at, so consider false for it.

title: dismiss_account_notice pops a force-logout service notice although its dialog is meant to be undismissable
trigger: Force-logout (AUTH_KEY_DROP_*) notice open (Esc, backdrop and close button disabled); any programmatic close of the AccountNotice kit dialog runs the registered close (agent-blocked layer close, close_window_boxes, left-dialog close in shell)
effect: The notice that must end in Log out is popped and never shown again; user is left in a dead session
fix: The Service arm of dismiss_account_notice should do nothing when the front notice is_force_logout, as the comment above it says.

title: Terms prompt step and age tick are never reset, so the next terms update opens on a stale step with the age box pre-ticked
trigger: Accept terms (age box ticked) or tap Decline then Decline and Delete; later the server sends another updateTermsOfService (or the first prompt is cleared from another device while the step is DeclineSorry/DeleteWarning)
effect: The new terms prompt opens straight on the Decline sorry / Delete account step instead of the terms text, or with the minimum-age confirmation already ticked so the user never confirms their age for the new terms
fix: Hold one TermsPrompt { terms_id, stage: Terms{age_ok, age_error}|DeclineSorry|DeleteWarning } keyed by the terms id; replace it whole when notices.terms changes or clears.

title: Agree and Continue ignores a failed acceptTermsOfService send, so the locked terms box does nothing and says nothing
trigger: Terms box open (not closable), network/sender down so driver.accept_terms returns Err (terms_in_flight reset to false)
effect: Tap Agree and Continue: button flashes back to idle, no error text, no toast; the box cannot be closed, user is stuck without feedback
fix: On Err set notices.terms_error (or a status note) from the send error; model terms acceptance as Fetch<()> with the error shown in the box.

title: Force-logout notice is dismissed before the logout request is sent, and a failed logout send is dropped
trigger: AUTH_KEY_DROP service notice shown; press Log out while request_logout returns Err (auth not Ready, sender error)
effect: The locked notice vanishes, the account stays on screen as if usable though the server dropped its key, no error shown, no way to get the notice back
fix: Dismiss the notice only after request_logout returns Ok (or when the LogOut answer lands); on Err keep the notice and show an error.

title: Passcode job result is thrown away when its window closed
trigger: Type the passcode on a chat window's lock screen (or press Turn on/off in the settings box) and close that window during the PBKDF2 run.
effect: run_passcode_job's Err branch only ends the job: a correct unlock leaves the global master key set but the app still locked and every window on the lock screen; a finished Turn off leaves enabled = true on a disk with no passcode, so the next lock cannot be opened. (system_unlock_wait handles this case, this path does not.)
fix: Run the result handler on the main window when the asking window is gone (as unlock_in_main_window does) so the answer always lands once; store the job as PasscodeJob::Running{kind, asker}.

title: Gifts grid can ask for the next page on every frame
trigger: Open the gifts panel of a box with more than one page while the driver refuses the request (auth not Ready, shutdown, or the owner not known).
effect: Each build of the last row defers QrAction::MoreGifts when gifts.wants_more is true. fetch_share_theme_gifts returns Err before gifts.start() sets loading, so wants_more stays true; the effect makes qr_act notify, the grid builds again and asks again.
fix: Set a retry deadline (or Fetch::Failed) in the early-Err path of fetch_share_theme_gifts, and make ThemeGifts one enum.

title: A color or emoji pick saved on close fails silently
trigger: In your own or a public group's QR box pick a color, close the box at once while offline or without the right to change info.
effect: close_qr_box runs QrAction::Closing, which sends the save, then drops the box. The answer arrives later and drain_peer_qr clears data.save_answers when no box is open, so the failure never reaches a toast and the user believes the share theme was saved.
fix: Report a failed close-time save through the app's status note (an owner that outlives the box) instead of discarding the answer.

title: QR box clock keeps asking for a contact link while Quill is locked
trigger: Open your own QR box (hidden number, temporary contact link with a countdown), lock Quill and wait past expiry.
effect: The box stays open under the lock (the lock drops what is drawn, close_for_lock does not close it). The 1 s qr_clock loop keeps running: ensure_qr_contact_link calls ensure_own_contact_link, which sends getUserLink, and qr_act(Tick) runs the reducer, with no refused_while_locked check.
fix: Gate qr_clock and ensure_qr_contact_link on lock_waits(), or close the QR box in close_for_lock.

title: Two-step password/email form clears and returns to Status even when the send failed
trigger: Change/enable/disable 2FA, press submit while set_two_step_password or set_recovery_email returns Err (connection not ready/shutdown).
effect: All inputs are emptied, the view goes to Status with no error line; the change was never sent and the typed password/hint/email are lost, so the box looks saved.
fix: Keep the form until the driver accepts; on Err set twofa.notice and stay on the form (a Submit stage enum: Editing/Sending/Failed).

title: `added` flag is only consumed by the ticker, which the lock ends: it sticks and closes the next Create box
trigger: Create a passkey, lock Quill while addLoginPasskey is in flight (ticker ends via close_passkey_ceremony_for_lock), the answer lands and sets PasskeysState::added; unlock, open Protect your account, press Create Passkey.
effect: The first tick of the new ticker takes the old added=true and sets about_open=false: the Protect your account box closes at once under the new ceremony.
fix: Turn adding/added/ceremony into one PasskeyAdd enum (Idle, Options, Adding, Added) consumed by whichever frame sees it, or reset added when the ticker starts.

title: A finished passkey ceremony is dropped silently when finish_register / finish_login refuses
trigger: Create Passkey, touch the key; between the ceremony start and its end `chats_path_active()` turned false (reconnect) or `adding` is still true from the previous try. For sign-in, the authorization state moved on.
effect: `let _ = live.driver.finish_register(&registration)` ignores the Err: the dialog closes as if saved but no passkey is added and no message is shown; the user touched the key for nothing.
fix: Surface the Err as a note and keep the dialog on an error sheet, or queue the registration until the connection is back.

title: Recovery and login-email forms clear the typed code, new password and hint right after sending, whatever the outcome
trigger: Forgot password > enter a wrong code and a new password > Save (or enter a bad login email > submit)
effect: The server rejects it but the inputs are already empty, so the user retypes everything; also cleared when the driver call itself returned Err (error ignored with let _)
fix: Clear inputs when the success answer arrives, and show the error when the send fails.

title: Code step shows the rejected new number after a failed Wrong number resend
trigger: On the code step press Wrong number?, type a number TDLib rejects (invalid, flood, banned) and press Continue. submit_phone (auth_ui.rs:79-80) sets submitted_phone and clears editing_phone as soon as the request is sent, not when TDLib accepts it.
effect: TDLib stays in WaitCode for the old number, the screen flips back to the code step, and its body says the code was sent to the new, rejected number (signin_view reads submitted_phone) with the error line under it.
fix: Hold the number as a SignInStep enum (EnterPhone, Sending{phone}, CodeSentTo{phone}) advanced by the auth state change, so a rejected send returns to EnterPhone with the old CodeSentTo intact.
